description: Illustrative Supabase stored table rows reconstructed from repository migrations through 2026-10-28. Each scenarios[].data validates against orders.schema.json. UUIDs, prices, campaign names and external references are samples; foreign-key targets are not provisioned. These are reference data, not checkout input or ready-to-import fixtures.
notes: No live Supabase database was inspected or changed.
All order and order-item columns are included. Snapshot objects are intentionally abbreviated; production preserves its full server-generated audit.
All allowed status, payment, line and discount enums are listed below. Prices and quantities have numeric ranges, so all numeric values cannot be enumerated.
Do not post these rows as checkout requests: the server calculates and saves prices, gifts, discounts and totals.
order_items has no current promotion_id column; product campaign IDs are inside pricing_snapshot.
order_promotions holds cart campaign audit. API-derived image_url, promotion_benefit, items and applied_cart_promotions are not columns of orders/order_items.
Order subtotal and product discounts include gift valuation; total_quantity excludes gifts.
Order total_quantity sums purchased transaction quantities even with mixed UOMs; use per-line base quantities for conversion.
The application-reference base_uom can differ from ERP Stock UOM.

Database insert triggers derive conversion and discount components from pricing_snapshot, accumulate order discount components, and capture order_promotions. Avoid manually pre-seeding those derived totals.
Tax is zero in current checkout; the nonzero-tax scenario demonstrates storage only.
